sentences.en: I leaned forward, eager to catch every word he spoke.
sentences.zh: 我向前倾身，急切地想听他说的每一句话。

sentences.en: He has a strong shoulder for you to lean on.
sentences.zh: 他有一个坚实的肩膀让你依靠。

sentences.en: He leaned over her and said, "No, I'm not lying."
sentences.zh: 他俯身对她说：“不，我没有撒谎。”
